title: Harness: SiliconFlow and DeepInfra as preferred routers, live-verified registry, provider-reported cost and model discovery
goal: SUSI_HARNESS_PREFER names the providers that lead the ladder and orchestrate; the siliconflow and deepinfra registries carry the models the providers serve today with their published prices; a provider that states its own cost (DeepInfra usage.estimated_cost) settles the ledger row at it; models --discover prints the chat models a keyed provider lists beyond the registry as an overlay with prices; docs updated; verified live against both providers.
